proposals.reason: Post-2022 official 'Á' glyph with underline, standalone compact SVG from Alfa-Bank's own design system (core-ds/ui-primitives master); base is an older stylized white-on-gradient-disc presentation of the same glyph.

judgement.rationale: The discussion contains a concrete request for the standard red circle and white letter, plus a submitted CHANGES_REQUESTED instruction to retain the logo from PR #1. Both requirements are retained. The saved discussion does not contain PR #1's logo or establish whether that referenced logo is the accepted gradient-disc baseline, the requested standard red-circle/white-letter variant, or another variant; therefore the two instructions cannot be safely treated as equivalent or one discarded solely because the other occurs later. Two APPROVED reviews have empty bodies and do not resolve the intended presentation. With research and owner questions prohibited, the exact retained/replacement target remains unresolved.
